text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Excuse me— I am Curren Bouquetd'or.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I might be... a little bad at 
competitions... However, I do have—a 
reason I want to win."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Gathering the flowers of victory... into 
a bouquet. Offering that golden bouquet to 
the one worthy of it— I am... fully 
prepared to do so."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
